reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` against `main`:

*P1 — Overlapping imports aren’t deduped by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` compares object references, not IDs. Two separately imported objects with the same `id` both survive `mergeImports`, violating the first-seen contract in `README.md:5`.

*Recommended fix:* Track seen `contact.id` values and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add a regression test using different objects with the same ID, including across two lists.

*Verification:* All 4 existing tests pass, but `mergeImports([{id: 1, name: 'Ada'}], [{id: 1, name: 'Ada updated'}])` returns both contacts. `test/dedupe.test.js` tests repeated references and distinct IDs, so it misses this case.

No other findings. No files changed.
